title: Build fails on modern GCC (>13) due to outdated OpenAL vendor
author: kouta-kun
body:
### Describe the feature or issue.

Hi! I wanted to report that currently touchHLE cannot be built on modern GCC distributions due to the version of OpenAL being vendored (related to issue https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/issues/846).

Updating the git submodule to the latest revision fixes the issue with no regressions as far as I can tell.
